betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Need to change your rocket's destination without climbing into the seat? The §6Guidance Computer Access Hatch§f gives you remote access to the Guidance Computer from outside the rocket frame.

Place it adjacent to the Rocket Assembling Machine, link it with a Linker, and you get a mirror of the computer's GUI. Insert Planet ID Chips, Space Station ID Chips, configure launch parameters, all from ground level.

This is essential for automated launch systems where you don't want someone sitting in every rocket. The hatch works within a short range of the computer, so you've got some flexibility in placement.

§ePS:§f Use a Wrench to rotate the hatch so its GUI face points toward your logistics corridor. Multiple hatches can connect to the same computer.
